section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the connection of the fifteenth of Av to the Third Beis HaMikdash, where the letters Vav-Hei will become like Yud-Hei, preventing any possibility of destruction or exile.
section.t: And the maamar continues
with an explanation of the connection of the fifteenth
[of Av]
to the Third Beis HaMikdash,
that in the future, even Vav-Hei will be in the aspect of Yud-Hei,
as it is written,
"On that day will be"
(the word "yihyeh" [will be] is twice the letters Yud-Hei).
And since the nourishment of the external forces is from the aspect of Vav-Hei
(Zeir Anpin and Nukvah),
unlike from the aspect of Yud-Hei
(Abba and Imma),
where nourishment cannot occur,
therefore,
in the future, when even Vav-Hei will be like Yud-Hei,
destruction and exile will no longer be applicable.
And the maamar adds,
that among the distinctions between Yud-Hei
(Abba and Imma)
and Vav-Hei
(Zeir Anpin and Nukvah)
is,
that Abba and Imma are two companions that never separate, while the union of Zeir Anpin and Nukvah is only intermittent.
And in the future, when Vav-Hei will be like Yud-Hei,
even the union of Vav-Hei will be perpetual.
And therefore,
the future Beis HaMikdash will be eternal.
[For in addition to the fact that in the future Beis HaMikdash destruction will not be applicable because the nourishment of the external forces will not be applicable then,
also the Beis HaMikdash itself will be in a manner that does not allow for interruption,
"a tent"
that shall not be shaken, its pegs shall not be pulled up forever].
And this is the connection of Yud-Hei
[of Av]
to the Third Beis HaMikdash,
for the quality of the Third Beis HaMikdash, that interruption is not applicable to it, is because it will be in the aspect of Yud-Hei.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the concept of "twice Yud-Hei" through the gematria of Va'eschanan and the curtains of the courtyard, linking it to the drawing down of Atik into Yud-Hei to elevate Zeir Anpin and Nukvah.
section.t: And the maamar continues
with an explanation of the matter of twice Yud-Hei, prefacing with the known concept
regarding the matter that "Va'eschanan" has the gematria of 515,
500 plus 15,
where 500 represents the five Chassadim of Arich
[each of which is comprised of one hundred]
and on a higher level, the five Chassadim of Atik,
and the meaning of 515 is that the five Chassadim of Arich and Atik shine in Yud-Hei.
And this is also the meaning of "fifteen cubits of curtains for the shoulder,"
fifteen
(cubits)
is Yud-Hei, and "shoulder" has the gematria of 500,
and the meaning of "fifteen cubits of curtains for the shoulder" is the drawing down of Atik into Yud-Hei.
And this is also the matter of twice Yud-Hei,
for in the courtyard of the Mishkan there were two shoulders, and on each of them were fifteen curtains,
and twice fifteen is twice Yud-Hei.
And it can be said,
that the connection of the fifteen curtains for the shoulder
(the drawing down of Atik into Yud-Hei)
with twice Yud-Hei
(that Zeir Anpin and Nukvah are like Abba and Imma)
is,
that according to the order of Hishtalshelus,
Zeir Anpin and Nukvah are lower than Abba and Imma,
and in order for Zeir Anpin and Nukvah to be like Abba and Imma, it is through the drawing down of the Kesser that is above Hishtalshelus,
and within Kesser itself – Atik.
And the distinction between the two explanations
(in the maamar)
is,
that the first explanation speaks about the matter of the elevation of Zeir Anpin and Nukvah,
and the second explanation speaks about the matter of the drawing down of Atik
(the root and cause of the elevation of Zeir Anpin and Nukvah).
And the maamar continues that the fifteenth of Av is also connected to the second explanation of twice Yud-Hei,
for on the fifteenth of Av there is a revelation of the five Chassadim of Atik in Abba and Imma,
and through this, a revelation of Atik is drawn down also into Malchus.
And the main revelation of this will be in the future,
except that a foretaste of this also shines now on the fifteenth of Av,
as mentioned above
(section 2)
that on the fifteenth of Av there is a foretaste of the future revelation.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section questions why the greatness of the fifteenth of Av, which is a foretaste of the incomparably greater future revelation, is specifically linked to the completion of the moon's illumination.
section.t: Now, the reason for this, that on the fifteenth of Av this revelation shines, is because the fifteenth of Av is the completion of the moon after the descent of Tisha B'Av
(as above, section 1).
And it needs to be understood,
that the essential standing of the moon in its completeness
(on the fifteenth of the month)
is only regarding its revelation.
For the moon itself is complete throughout all the days of the month,
and the quality of the fifteenth is that the completeness of the moon is in revelation.
And since all matters in the Torah are with utmost precision,
it must be said,
that the quality of the fifteenth of Av is in the matter of revelation.
And it requires explanation,
for on the fifteenth of Av there is a foretaste of the revelation of the future Beis HaMikdash,
which will be
(in addition to the revelation of the First and Second Temples)
greater than the First and Second Temples,
and the greatness of the Third Temple over the First and Second is an incomparable greatness,
as is also understood from what is explained above
(section 3)
that the Third Beis HaMikdash is connected with the matter of twice Yud-Hei, that Zeir Anpin and Nukvah will be like Abba and Imma, and that in Abba and Imma there will be a revelation of Atik,
and nevertheless,
they connect the quality of the fifteenth of Av with this, that on the fifteenth is the completion of the moon,
completion in the matter of revelation.
